name: Laubressel
summary: The allied army of Bohemia followed up its success at Bar-sur-Aube and beat Macdonald and Oudinot again at Laubressel, east of Troyes.

toCome.name: Gérard's Corps
toCome.formation: Duhesme's and Hamelinaye's divisions and Jarry's brigade, II Corps
toCome.summary: Held the bridge of La Guillotière, where Duhesme lost two guns and four hundred men; Bellair's brigade of Hamelinaye's division was routed, and Gérard drew back into Troyes.

toCome.name: Oudinot's Corps
toCome.formation: Rothembourg's, Leval's, Chassé's and Pacthod's divisions, VII Corps
toCome.summary: Rothembourg's Young Guard held the plateau of Laubressel until Wittgenstein's Russians came round its flank.

toCome.name: Macdonald's Corps
toCome.formation: Albert's, Brayer's and Amey's divisions, XI Corps (Molitor)
toCome.summary: Fell back on Troyes without being pressed.

toCome.name: Saint-Germain's Cavalry
toCome.formation: Maurin's and Delort's divisions, II Cavalry Corps
toCome.summary: Maurin's horse retook most of the artillery park Pahlen's cavalry had overrun at Thennelières.

toCome.name: Milhaud's Cavalry
toCome.formation: Piré's, Briche's and L'Héritier's divisions, V Cavalry Corps
toCome.summary: Fell back with the infantry without being engaged.

toCome.name: Kellermann's Cavalry
toCome.formation: Jacquinot's and Trelliard's divisions, VI Cavalry Corps
toCome.summary: Trelliard's dragoons counter-attacked the Russians at Thennelières; Jacquinot's division stampeded at La Chapelle-Saint-Luc.

toCome.name: Wittgenstein's Corps
toCome.formation: Gorchakov's I and Eugen of Württemberg's II Infantry Corps and Pahlen's cavalry, VI Corps
toCome.summary: About fourteen thousand men, who took Bouranton and the Laubressel plateau while Pahlen's horse raided the French artillery park.

toCome.name: Wrede's Corps
toCome.formation: Three Bavarian and two Austrian divisions, V Corps
toCome.summary: About twenty thousand men, whose guns opened the attack; they pushed on towards Troyes.

toCome.name: The Crown Prince of Württemberg's Corps
toCome.formation: Koch's and Döring's divisions and Prince Adam's cavalry, IV Corps
toCome.summary: About fifteen thousand men on the allied left, who followed Macdonald towards Sens.

toCome.name: Gyulai's Corps
toCome.formation: Crenneville's, Fresnel's and Hohenlohe's divisions, III Corps
toCome.summary: About ten thousand Austrians, who attacked at Silvarouvres.
